40356-cathedral-cities-of-spain.creator: W. W. Collins, R.I.
40356-cathedral-cities-of-spain.description: A book by W. W. Collins, R.I.. At one time the greatest port in the world--"Where are thy glories now, oh, Cadiz?" She is still a White City lying embosomed on a sea of emerald and topaz. Her streets are still full of the colour of the East, but alas!

arxiv-1704-03299.title: A new Generalized fractional derivative and integral Thanks: 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 26A33, 26D10, 26D15.
arxiv-1704-03299.creator: Abdullah Akkurt 1, ∗ , M. Esra YILDIRIM 2 and Hüseyin YILDIRIM 1
arxiv-1704-03299.description: Abstract . In this article, we introduce a new general definition of fractional derivative and fractional integral, which depends on an unknown kernel. By using these definitions, we obtain the basic properties of fractional integral and fractional derivative such as Product Rule, Quotient Rule, Chain Rule, Roll’s Theorem and Mean Value Theorem. We give some examples. 1.

arxiv-1709-09814.title: Search for supersymmetry in events with one lepton and multiple jets exploiting the angular correlation between the lepton and the missing transverse momentum in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-1709-09814.description: Abstract Results are presented from a search for supersymmetry in events with a single electron or muon and hadronic jets. The data correspond to a sample of proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV with an integrated luminosity of 35.9 \fbinv , recorded in 2016 by the CMS experiment.

arxiv-1901-04011.title: A Deep Recurrent Q Network towards Self-adapting Distributed Microservices architecture
arxiv-1901-04011.creator: Basel Magableh
arxiv-1901-04011.description: Abstract One desired aspect of microservices architecture is the ability to self-adapt its own architecture and behaviour in response to changes in the operational environment. To achieve the desired high levels of self-adaptability, this research implements the distributed microservices’ architectures model, as informed by the MAPE-K model.

arxiv-2002-05266.title: Topological magnonics in the two-dimensional van der Waals magnet CrI 3 \text{CrI}_{3}
arxiv-2002-05266.creator: Esteban Aguilera, R. Jaeschke-Ubiergo, N. Vidal-Silva, L. E. F. Foa Torres, A. S. Nunez
arxiv-2002-05266.description: Abstract In this article, we calculate the magnon spectrum of Kitaev-Heisenberg magnets. This model has been recently proposed as a spin Hamiltonian to model CrI 3 \text{CrI}_{3} and other two-dimensional magnets. It is a minimal spin Hamiltonian that includes a contribution stemming from a Heisenberg, isotropic exchange, and a contribution arising from a Kitaev interaction, anisotropic and frustrated exchange.

arxiv-2005-12351.title: fmmgen: Automatic Code Generation of Operators for Cartesian Fast Multipole and Barnes-Hut Methods
arxiv-2005-12351.creator: Ryan Pepper, Hans Fangohr
arxiv-2005-12351.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Ryan Pepper, Hans Fangohr. The Barnes-Hut and Fast Multipole Methods are widely utilised methods applied in order to reduce the computational cost of evaluating long range forces in N N -body simulations. Despite this, applying existing libraries to simple problems with higher order source points, such as dipoles, is not straightforward or efficient because individual libraries are optimised towards specific problems, normally solving for the potential and field of a set of Coulombic particles.

arxiv-2007-00596.title: A New Basis for Sparse Principal Component Analysis
arxiv-2007-00596.creator: Fan Chen, Karl Rohe
arxiv-2007-00596.description: Abstract Previous versions of sparse principal component analysis (PCA) have presumed that the eigen-basis (a p × k p\times k matrix) is approximately sparse. We propose a method that presumes the p × k p\times k matrix becomes approximately sparse after a k × k k\times k rotation.

arxiv-2012-13662.title: Coarse to Fine: Multi-label Image Classification with Global/Local Attention Thanks: This work was supported by the Natural Science Foundation of China (Nos. 61472267, 61728205, 61502329, 61672371) and Primary Research & Developement Plan of Jiangsu Province (No. BE2017663).
arxiv-2012-13662.creator: Fan Lyu, Fuyuan Hu, Victor S. Sheng, Zhengtian Wu, Qiming Fu, Baochuan Fu
arxiv-2012-13662.description: Abstract In our daily life, the scenes around us are always with multiple labels especially in a smart city, i.e., recognizing the information of city operation to response and control. Great efforts have been made by using Deep Neural Networks to recognize multi-label images.

arxiv-2209-03001.title: Optimizing Demonstrated Robot Manipulation Skills for Temporal Logic Constraints
arxiv-2209-03001.creator: Akshay Dhonthi 1 2 § , Philipp Schillinger 1 , Leonel Rozo 1 and Daniele Nardi 3
arxiv-2209-03001.description: Abstract For performing robotic manipulation tasks, the core problem is determining suitable trajectories that fulfill the task requirements. Various approaches to compute such trajectories exist, being learning and optimization the main driving techniques. Our work builds on the learning-from-demonstration (LfD) paradigm, where an expert demonstrates motions, and the robot learns to imitate them.

arxiv-2210-06585.title: Towards an Efficient ML System: Unveiling a Trade-off between Task Accuracy and Engineering Efficiency in a Large-scale Car Sharing Platform DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 CCS: Computing methodologies Artificial Intelligence
arxiv-2210-06585.creator: Kyung Ho Park*, Hyunhee Chung*, Soonwoo Kwon
arxiv-2210-06585.description: Abstract . Upon the significant performance of the supervised deep neural networks, conventional procedures of developing ML system are task-centric , which aims to maximize the task accuracy. However, we scrutinized this task-centric ML system lacks in engineering efficiency when the ML practitioners solve multiple tasks in their domain.

arxiv-2211-09970.title: Estimating defection in subscription-type markets: empirical analysis from the scholarly publishing industry Journal: TEAC CCS: Applied computing Economics CCS: Mathematics of computing Probabilistic algorithms CCS: Computing methodologies Ensemble methods CCS: Applied computing Forecasting CCS: App
arxiv-2211-09970.creator: Michael Roberts, J. Ignacio Deza, Hisham Ihshaish, Yanhui Zhu
arxiv-2211-09970.description: Abstract . We present the first empirical study on customer churn prediction in the scholarly publishing industry. The study examines our proposed method for prediction on a customer subscription data over a period of 6.5 years, which was provided by a major academic publisher.

arxiv-2308-02323.title: Dataflow Dialogue Generation
arxiv-2308-02323.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . We demonstrate task-oriented dialogue generation within the dataflow dialogue paradigm. We show an example of agenda driven dialogue generation for the MultiWOZ domain, and an example of generation without an agenda for the SMCalFlow domain, where we show an improvement in the accuracy of the translation of user requests to dataflow expressions when the generated dialogues are used to augment the translation training dataset.

arxiv-2404-03352.title: ToMCCA: A Toy Monte Carlo Coalescence Afterburner
arxiv-2404-03352.creator: Maximilian Mahlein, Chiara Pinto, Laura Fabbietti
arxiv-2404-03352.description: Abstract Antinuclei in our Galaxy may stem either from annihilation or decay of dark matter, or from collisions of cosmic rays with the interstellar medium, which constitute the background of indirect dark matter searches. Understanding the formation mechanism of (anti)nuclei is crucial for setting limits on their production in space.

arxiv-2405-18551.title: Photorealistic Robotic Simulation using Unreal Engine 5 for Agricultural Applications
arxiv-2405-18551.creator: Xingjian Li, Lirong Xiang
arxiv-2405-18551.description: Abstract This work presents a new robotics simulation environment built upon Unreal Engine 5 (UE5) for agricultural image data generation. The simulation utilizes the state-of-the-art real-time rendering engine to provide realistic plant images which are often used in agricultural applications.

arxiv-2410-03405.title: The scaling behaviour of localised and extended states in one-dimensional tight-binding models with disorder
arxiv-2410-03405.creator: Luca Schaefer, Barbara Drossel
arxiv-2410-03405.description: Abstract We investigate two one-dimensional tight-binding models with disorder that have extended states at zero energy. We use exact and partial diagonalisation of the Hamiltonian to obtain the eigenmodes and the associated participation ratios, and the transfer-matrix method to determine the localisation length. The first model has no on-site disorder, but random couplings.

arxiv-2502-14049.title: Rectifiability of the singular strata for harmonic maps to Euclidean buildings Thanks: CB supported in part by NSF DMS CAREER-1750254
arxiv-2502-14049.creator: Christine Breiner, Ben K. Dees
arxiv-2502-14049.description: Abstract . We define a natural notion of the singular strata for harmonic maps into F F -connected complexes (which include locally finite Euclidean buildings), and prove the rectifiability of these strata. We additionally establish bounds on the Minkowski content for certain quantitative strata, following the rectifiable Reifenberg program of [ NV17 ] .

arxiv-2502-21180.title: S ​ O ​ ( 10 ) {SO(10)} theory on the plateau: the importance of being renormalizable
arxiv-2502-21180.creator: Anca Preda 1 , Goran Senjanović 2,3 and Michael Zantedeschi 4
arxiv-2502-21180.description: Abstract We revisit a minimal renormalisable S ​ O ​ ( 10 ) SO(10) grand unified theory, with the Higgs representation 45 H 45_{\rm H} , 126 H 126_{\rm H} and complex 10 H 10_{\rm H} , responsible for the unification, intermediate and the weak scale symmetry breaking, respectively.

arxiv-2504-05131.title: One-loop transverse-momentum-dependent soft function at higher orders in the dimensional regulator
arxiv-2504-05131.creator: Hua-Sheng Shao and Guoxing Wang
arxiv-2504-05131.description: Abstract The transverse-momentum-dependent (TMD) soft function for a generic hadroproduction process involving massive colored particles is analytically calculated at the one-loop level, extended to higher orders in the dimensional regulator ϵ \epsilon . We present both the azimuthal-angle-averaged and azimuthal-angle-dependent soft functions in impact-parameter space, making them suitable for small q T q_{T} resummation calculations.

arxiv-2508-00284.title: Signature of a magnetar central engine with precession motion in the X-ray emission of GRB 220711B 20262025
arxiv-2508-00284.creator: Ying-Ze Shan, Xing Yang, Hou-Jun Lü, Jared Rice, Hao-Yu Yuan, Xue-Zhao Chang, Zhao Joseph Zhang, Le Zou, En-Wei Liang
arxiv-2508-00284.description: Abstract The γ \gamma -ray light curve of long-duration GRB 220711B, is characterized by a multi-peaked structure with a duration lasting ∼ \sim 105 seconds. More interestingly, the X-ray afterglow light curve is composed of a plateau emission smoothly connected with a ∼ t − 2 \sim t^{-2} segment overlapping some flares followed by an extremely steep decay.

arxiv-2511-16238.title: Numerical identification of the time-dependent coefficient in the heat equation with fractional Laplacian
arxiv-2511-16238.creator: Arshyn Altybay, Niyaz Tokmagambetov, Gulzat Nalzhupbayeva
arxiv-2511-16238.description: Abstract . We address the inverse problem of identifying a time-dependent source coefficient in a one-dimensional heat equation with a fractional Laplacian subject to Dirichlet boundary conditions and an integral nonlocal data. An a priori estimate is established to ensure the uniqueness and stability of the solution.

arxiv-2511-17574.title: Constructing Political Coordinates: Aggregating Over the Opposition for Diverse News Recommendation
arxiv-2511-17574.creator: Eamon Earl 2 3 , Chen Ding 2 , Richard Valenzano 2 3 , and Drai Paulen-Patterson 2 3
arxiv-2511-17574.description: Abstract In the past two decades, open access to news and information has increased rapidly, empowering educated political growth within democratic societies. News recommender systems (NRSs) have shown to be useful in this process, minimizing political disengagement and information overload by providing individuals with articles on topics that matter to them.

arxiv-2512-10613.title: Inflation at the End of 2025: Constraints on r r and n s n_{\mathrm{s}} Using the Latest CMB and BAO Data
arxiv-2512-10613.creator: L. Balkenhol 1,∗, E. Camphuis 1, F. Finelli 2,3, K. Benabed 1, F. R. Bouchet 1, J. Carron 4,5, S. Galli 1, E. Hivon 1, A. R. Khalife 1, L. Knox 6, C. L. Reichardt 7, A. Vitrier 1, W. L. K. Wu 8
arxiv-2512-10613.description: Abstract Inflation elegantly provides initial conditions for the standard model of cosmology, while solving the horizon, flatness, and magnetic monopole problems. Inflationary models make predictions for the tensor-to-scalar ratio r r and the spectral index n s n_{\mathrm{s}} of initial density fluctuations.

arxiv-2602-09804.title: Large time decay of the Oseen flow in exterior domains subject to the Navier slip-with-friction boundary condition
arxiv-2602-09804.creator: Toshiaki Hishida
arxiv-2602-09804.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Toshiaki Hishida. Consider the motion of a viscous incompressible fluid filling a 3D exterior domain Ω \Omega subject to the Navier slip-with-friction boundary condition as well as outflow at infinity. For the Oseen system as the linearization, we discuss the resolvent set under a certain relationship among the geometry of the boundary ∂ Ω \partial\Omega , friction coefficient α ⁡ ( x ) \alpha(x) and the outflow u ∞ u_{\infty} .

pmc-10525922.title: Which Comes First, Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease or Arterial Hypertension?
pmc-10525922.creator: Julia A. Golubeva, Anna F. Sheptulina, Anastasia Yu. Elkina, Ekaterina O. Liusina, Anton R. Kiselev, Oxana M. Drapkina
pmc-10525922.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and arterial hypertension (AH) are widespread noncommunicable diseases in the global population. Since hypertension and NAFLD are diseases associated with metabolic syndrome, they are often comorbid. In fact, many contemporary published studies confirm the association of these diseases with each other, regardless of whether other metabolic factors, such as obesity, dyslipidemia, and type 2 diabetes mellites, are present. This narrative review considers the features of the association between NAFLD and AH, as well as possible pathophysiological mechanisms.

pmc-11295226.title: Comparison of Trends and Complications of Unicompartmental Knee Arthroplasty Versus Periarticular Knee Osteotomy Among ABOS Part II Oral Examination Candidates
pmc-11295226.creator: Kylie T Callan, Eric Smith, Theofilos Karasavvidis, Dean Wang
pmc-11295226.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:While unicompartmental knee arthroplasty (UKA) and osteotomy procedures are commonly used to treat knee osteoarthritis, the differences in complication profiles between procedures are still poorly understood.Purpose/Hypothesis:The purpose of this study was to assess the trends and complication rates of UKA and periarticular knee osteotomy for knee osteoarthritis among newly trained surgeons by using the American Board of Orthopaedic Surgery (ABOS) Part II Oral Examination Case List database.

pmc-11526100.title: Community composition and seasonal dynamics of microplastic biota in the Eastern Mediterranean Sea
pmc-11526100.creator: Keren Davidov, Katherine S Marsay, Sheli Itzahri, Maxim Rubin-Blum, Paula Sobral, Chana F Kranzler, Matan Oren
pmc-11526100.description: Marine plastic pollution poses a growing environmental threat, with microplastics accumulating in the global oceans. This study profiles the seasonal dynamics and taxonomic composition of the plastisphere, the microplastic ecosystem, in the Eastern Mediterranean Sea. Using long-read 16 S and 18 S metabarcoding, we analyzed offshore microplastic and whole seawater samples across each season over a two-year period.

pmc-12381418.title: Microbial Strains in Fermented Dairy: Unlocking Biofunctional Properties and Health Benefits
pmc-12381418.creator: Anuradha Wijesekara, Viraj Weerasingha, Shishanthi Jayarathna, Janak K. Vidanarachchi, Hasitha Priyashantha
pmc-12381418.description: Fermented dairy products like yoghurt, cheese, and kefir are essential for human nutrition and health. They offer a wide range of biofunctional properties, providing unique flavors along with substantial nutritional and therapeutic benefits. The inclusion of functional microorganisms, including probiotics, in dairy products offers a nutrient-dense matrix that promotes microbial viability, ensuring health advantages.

pmc-12551130.title: Prediction of postoperative haemorrhage after cerebral tumour surgery using machine learning algorithms
pmc-12551130.creator: Yasin Göktürk, Seyit Kağan Başarslan, Şule Göktürk, Hikmet Kocaman, Hasan Yıldırım
pmc-12551130.description: BackgroundTraditional diagnostic methods used by neurosurgeons are limited in their ability to address complex interactions. These limitations have necessitated the use of advanced artificial intelligence approaches capable of analyzing multidimensional data with greater precision in neurosurgical clinics. Postoperative intracranial hemorrhage is a critical complication following cerebral tumor surgery, often associated with increased morbidity and mortality.

pmc-12572829.title: Employing Yarning to Explore the Impact of Endorsed Midwives in an Aboriginal Medical Service
pmc-12572829.creator: Assimina Di Lollo, Susan Smith, Tahlia Johnson, Nina Sivertsen
pmc-12572829.description: AimThe aim of this study was to explore the role of Endorsed Midwives employed in an Aboriginal Medical Service (AMS) and to assess the impact on Aboriginal mothers and babies using the service.BackgroundCurrent research on the role of the Endorsed Midwife (EM) is limited, with no available evidence regarding its application in an AMS setting.

pmc-12626094.title: Chiral Molecules in Action: Chemistry of Chiral Perovskite and Perovskite-Inspired Materials
pmc-12626094.creator: Ramavath Babu, Julian E. Heger, Taniya Dutta, Xiaowen Hu, Narayan Pradhan, Peter Müller-Buschbaum, Sergio Gómez-Graña, Lakshminarayana Polavarapu
pmc-12626094.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The emergence of chiral metal halides marks a pivotal advancement in materials science, where structural asymmetry enables unprecedented control over spin-selective transport and polarized light interactions for optoelectronic and spintronic technologies. The introduction of chiral ligands into the metal halide lattice or on the surface of NCs imparts chirality to the corresponding hybrid materials, which adapts the handedness (R or S) of the chiral molecule.

pmc-13412995.title: Clinical Positioning and Implementation of a Deep-Learning Retinal Biomarker (Reti-CVD) for Cardiovascular Risk Stratification: A Narrative Review
pmc-13412995.creator: Junseung Rho, Sung-Goo Kang, Se-Hong Kim, Sang-Wook Song
pmc-13412995.description: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) prevention depends on accurate risk stratification before symptoms develop. Standard tools such as the Pooled Cohort Equations, QRISK3, and SCORE2 require laboratory data and are less informative in borderline-risk individuals, creating a role for accessible adjuncts. Retinal imaging directly visualizes the systemic microvasculature, and deep-learning oculomics may provide complementary risk information.

pmc-13540591.title: Reversing Dysfunction of CCR9+ Regulatory T Cells by Targeting the IL-21/IL-17 Axis Improves Type 1 Diabetes
pmc-13540591.creator: Yulian Xia, Qing He, Yuhui Yao, Lei Yang, Shanshan Zhan, Shunfeng Mao
pmc-13540591.description: ObjectiveThe functional status of regulatory T cells expressing the gut-homing receptor CCR9 (CCR9+ Tregs) in type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) remains unclear. This study aims to investigate the functional alterations of CCR9+ Tregs in a T1DM model and evaluate the interventional effect of targeting the IL-21/IL-17 axis on their dysfunction.MethodsThe spontaneous T1DM non-obese diabetic (NOD) mouse model was employed.
